name: Servant (K'kree)
description: Servant-caste K'kree fulfil necessary but low-status functions such as farming, basic maintenance, and providing the bulk of combat troops. They support the herd and die for it if necessary.

service.name: Service
service.description: You support the herd through farming, maintenance, and direct service to higher-caste families.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: You serve as a rank-and-file warrior, forming the backbone of the K'kree military.

mishaps.1: Injured in a predator or enemy attack. Lose D3 points from among STR, DEX and END. You do not leave the career.
mishaps.2: You anger your herdlord and are punished with a period of ostracism. Gain one level of Outsider skill. You do not leave the career.
mishaps.3: One of your wives dies or is otherwise taken from you. In your grief you offend many other K'kree. Gain D3 Rivals or one Enemy and lose a wife. You do not leave the career.
mishaps.4: Your status in the herd is diminished. If you accept this, SOC -1 and gain an Ally who respects your correct attitude. If you refuse, gain Outsider 1 and an Enemy. You do not leave the career.
mishaps.5: D3 of your family members are killed or otherwise lost. Their sacrifice compensates with SOC +1 (which may elevate you to the next caste). You do not leave the career.
mishaps.6: You were ejected from the herd. Gain 1 level of Outsider skill. You are no longer a K'kree; you are nothing.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your herd is involved in a highly successful endeavour. You do your part with honour, earning deserved praise from your herdlord and an additional Benefits roll. You also gain D3 Enemies.
events.4: Your herd goes on a mission. You complete your tasks to the herdlord's satisfaction. Gain 1 Contact or 1 level in any skill available to this caste.
events.5: You are given an onerous task you do not know how to complete. Roll INT 10+. On success, gain Jack-of-All-Trades 1 and a Rival made to look stupid. On failure, you suffer humiliation and abuse.
events.6: Your herd needs to prepare for war. Gain 1 level in Melee or Gun Combat.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the K'kree Life Events table.
events.8: Your herd meets with many others for a great ceremony. Gain 1 level of Profession (K'kree Ritual) and a Contact outside your herd.
events.9: You have to follow your herdlord on a space voyage. It is unpleasant, especially when they make you practice wearing a vacc suit. Gain 1 level of Vacc Suit.
events.10: You serve well and are personally commended by the Steppelord. Gain SOC +1 and a Contact at the Steppelord's court.
events.11: An important Merchant-caste leader offers you one of his daughters in marriage. Gain an extra wife, SOC 7, elevation to servant-of-rankholder in the Merchant caste and the admiration of your former peers.
events.12: A relative of yours was lost for a time, then came home as one-with-the-sky. You are not sure what to make of his ramblings but gain D3 Contacts among the dignitaries who have come to hear them and also SOC +1.

4.benefit: Gun Combat 1 or Recon 1 or Drive 1

notes: K'kree males only. SOC 1-6. Term 1 must use the Warrior skill table (all K'kree males serve as warriors in their first term). From term 2, use the assignment's skill table.
